# Business Process Pattern Audit

Capability ID: buildflow-process-audit-machine-v1
Commercial state: verification_required
Machine state: owned_runtime_migration_pending
Public URL: https://github.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/tree/main/public/chum/capabilities/buildflow-process-audit-machine-v1
Preferred agent route: universal fallback
Universal Evercraft MCP: https://fabric.systemiacommandcenters.com/mcp
Start here: Not a current sell-now route

## Use this when

- map how our process actually works
- find bottlenecks in this business workflow
- analyze our purchase approval process
- reconstruct our process from logs
- where are exceptions slowing us down
- audit our procure to pay workflow
- compare the real workflow to company policy
- process mining from operational history

## Problem

A business has fragmented operational events and wants to discover the real recurring workflow, cycle time and exception points without replacing its current systems first.

## Inputs

Tenant-scoped process observations/events and optional process/source-system scope.

## Outputs

Candidate step sequence, sample size, median duration, exception rate, confidence, evidence refs and review state. No policy change or external action.

## Pricing

No approved machine price/payment path was found. Do not auto-quote.

## Invocation and authority

MIGRATION HOLD: legacy Base44 route removed. Use Evercraft Fabric for discovery; direct execution, checkout and fulfillment require independent owned-runtime verification.

Pattern discovery may analyze authorized data. Observed behavior is never silently promoted to configured policy.

Payment authority: No verified Evercraft Payments path.

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
